definitions.explanation: Crab meat preserved in a can — a common ingredient for salads, fried rice, and other dishes when fresh crab is unavailable.

examples.japanese: カニ{缶|かん}を{開|あ}ける。
examples.english: To open a can of crab.

examples.japanese: サラダにカニ{缶|かん}を{入|い}れる。
examples.english: To add canned crab to a salad.

examples.japanese: カニ{缶|かん}は{値段|ねだん}が{高|たか}いので{特別|とくべつ}な{日|ひ}に{使|つか}う。
examples.english: Canned crab is expensive, so we use it on special occasions.

notes:
USAGE: カニ{缶|かん} is canned (tinned) crab meat, combining {カニ} (crab) with {缶|かん} (can). It is a convenient substitute for fresh crab in cooking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- カニ{缶|かん}を{開|あ}ける: to open a can of crab
- カニ{缶詰|かんづ}め: canned crab (as a product)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {缶詰|かんづめ}: canned food — the general category
- ズワイガニ: snow crab — a crab often used for canning
